title: Alleged OpenAI spy vibe-coded a surveillance device using his wife's chatbot account
text:
A Saudi national working as an engineer at OpenAI was arrested for allegedly planting an audio recording device, wrapped in toilet paper, inside the company's executive conference room. According to the indictment, he built the spy tool by vibe-coding it with a chatbot. If convicted, he faces up to five years in prison.
The article Alleged OpenAI spy vibe-coded a surveillance device using his wife's chatbot account appeared first on The Decoder.
